Privacy Policy

Introduction

Saudia is committed to respecting your privacy and protecting your personal information

  • We will be transparent about the information we are collecting and what we will do with it.
  • We will use the information you give us for the purposes described in our Privacy Policy, which include providing you with services you have requested and enhancing your experience with Saudia.
  • We will also use the information to help us understand you better and so that we can give you relevant offers.
  • If you tell us, you don’t want to receive marketing messages we will stop sending them. We will, of course, continue to send essential information relating to a product or service you have purchased to keep you informed about your booking and travel itinerary.
  • We will put in place measures to protect your information and keep it secure.
  • We will respect your data protection rights and aim to give you control over your own information.

You can access our full Privacy Policy below to help you to understand better how we use your personal information. In it, we explain in more detail the types of personal information we collect, how we collect it, what we may use it for and who we may share it with.

Without prejudice to your rights under applicable laws, the above and the Privacy Policy are not contractual and do not form part of your contract with us.

Full Privacy Policy

Controller of Personal Information

Any personal information processed by Saudia in connection with this Privacy Policy is controlled by Saudia, which is considered the “data controller” of your personal information Under Saudia Personal Data Protection law (PDPL) and European Union and UK data protection law. To contact the Data Protection Officer, please visit our Contact Form page.

If you have made a flight booking with us but one or more flights are to be provided by other airline(s) then that other airline will also separately be considered a “Data Controller” under data protection law. You can access the privacy policies of the other airlines via their own websites.

Any provider of services such as a hotel or car rental company will also separately be a “Data Controller”. You can access the privacy policies of those providers from them directly.

 

How to contact us ?

Please conduct our data protection officer of Saudia Group

Data Protection Office

SAUDI ARABIAN AIRLINES CORPORATION, P.O. Box 620, Jeddah 21231, Prince Saud Al Faisal Street, Al-Khaldia District, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Please send your request to the Data Protection Officer via our Contact Form.

Updates to this Privacy policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to keep it up to date with legal requirements and updates to our business operations. Any modifications will be published on this webpage and within the privacy sections of the relevant platforms to ensure transparency and accessibility.

What do we mean by personal information?

Personal information means details which identify you or could be used to identify you, such as your name and contact details, your travel arrangements and purchase history. It may also include information about how you use our websites and mobile applications.

When does this policy apply?

This Privacy Policy applies to personal information about you that we collect, use and otherwise process regarding your relationship with us as a customer or potential customer, including when you travel with us or use our other services, use All Saudia Channels such as websites, mobile applications, new technologies and platform that related to Saudia, contact our service agents or call centres and book to use our services through third parties (such as travel agents and other airlines).

Where we reference that others are data controllers in the sections ’Controller of Personal Information’ and ’Who do we share your personal information with?’ you should consult their privacy policies for further information.

Additional Terms and Conditions or policies may apply if you elect to take additional services from us such as making a Highlife purchase on board, using our on-board Wi-Fi or entering a competition linked to Saudia and other third parties.

How can we protect your personal information secure?

We take great care to protect the personal information you provide to us. You can read more about how we do this in our Data Protection Policy. Here are some things you can do to keep your information secure.

We have implemented robust technical and organizational security measures, policies, and procedures to protect your personal information and ensure its privacy. These include:

  • Imposing confidentiality obligations on our staff and service providers
  • Safely disposing of or anonymizing personal data when it is no longer needed
  • Adhering to security protocols for storing and sharing personal information to prevent unauthorized access

Cookies

A "cookie" is a small file placed on your device that collects information about how you interact with our website, mobile applications, and the internet. This data allows us to improve our services and customize content to better suit your preferences. For more details, please read our Cookies Policy.

Keep your booking reference confidential

When you make a booking, you will be given a booking reference (also known as a PNR or Passenger Name Record). This will appear on the email confirmation or ticket of each person in your booking.

You should always keep your booking reference confidential. Giving your booking reference to others may allow them to access your booking details through our systems.

If you are travelling with others and would not like your individual booking details to be accessible by them, you may prefer each person to make separate bookings.

Marketing Communications and messages Related to Your Experience with Saudia

We may send you electronic communication such as app push notification, email address, SMS, Phone number relating to marketing activities, flight booking, baggage services, ticketing, check- in services, and other services associated with your experience with Saudia.

You may receive travel-related information, promotional offers, customer satisfaction surveys, and newsletters from Saudia, other companies within the Saudia Group, or selected partner companies through the communication channels you choose, such as email, SMS, or push notifications.

These communications may be tailored to you using technologies that help us understand whether you have opened a message or interacted with our electronic marketing communications.

Loyalty / web app log-in details confidential

To make sure your access to our websites, other online services, and mobile applications is secure, you should not share your log in details with anyone else. When you finish using the website, online services or mobile app you should log out if others may be able to access your computer or device. This is especially important if you are using a publicly accessible computer.

Be aware of and protect yourself against Internet fraud and ‘phishing’

There is an Internet fraud practice known as ‘phishing’ which is the illegal gathering of personal information by deception. Unsolicited emails are sent to individuals from lists illegally gathered by a third party, and recipients are asked to enter or reconfirm bank or password details into a 'cloned' or illegal copy website.

When do we collect personal information about you?

We collect personal information about you whenever you use our services (whether these services are provided by us or by other companies or agents acting on our behalf), including when you travel with us, when you use our website or mobile applications, or interact with us via email or use our contact centers.

We collect also personal data about you such as email address and phone number when you interact with our website and mobile apps. This data is used to track conversions and enhance ad performance. With Enhanced Conversions, we securely hash first-party data before sending it to Google.

For additional details see ’What types of personal information do we collect and retain?’ below.

In addition, we may receive personal information about you from third parties, such as:

  • Companies contracted by us to provide services to you.
  • Companies involved in your travel plans, including airlines involved in your prior or onward journey, relevant airport operators and customs and immigration authorities.
  • Companies that participate in our loyalty schemes and other customer programmes (e.g. car hire providers and hotels).
  • Companies who provide details to us under privacy polices providing information to be shared with Saudia.

What types of personal information do we collect and retain?

When you use our services, you will need to provide us with your personal details or the details of those individual(s) who will be travelling.

Types of personal information we collect depend on the nature of your interaction with us. Typically, the information includes:

  • Full name/Title
  • Date of birth
  • Address 
  • Contact information (email, mobile number)
  • Booking reference/PNR (Passenger Name Record) number
  • Gender
  • Passport details 
  • Country of residence/Nationality
  • Emergency contact details
  • Payment card details
  • Loyalty program membership number
  • Preferences (such as meal choices, language, seating, aircraft type, and lifestyle interests)
  • Destination address where required (i.e. the US)

We collect the following categories of personal information:

  • Information you provide for Saudia to complete and manage a booking you have made with us or a service you have requested from us.
  • Information collected during your travel with us.
  • Information about your travel arrangements.
  • Information about the services we have provided to you in the past.
  • Information about online registration and other interactions.
  • Information about your use of our websites, contact centres and mobile applications. For more details of the methods please see 'How we use cookies and other methods for the collection of website usage data'.
  • Information about your device and your location if you have been browsing on www.Saudia.com or using our mobile application, for example your IP address or unique device ID. (An IP address (i.e. Internet Protocol address) is a numeric code that can act as a unique identifier for your computer or other device – this can be turned off from your device).

When and why do we collect ‘sensitive personal data’?

Certain categories of personal information, typically, the information includes:

  • health or medical condition
  • religion (for special religious flight bookings (such as Hajj travel) and immigration requirements)
  • biometric data
  • Race/ Ethnicity

    • The categories of sensitive personal information requiring additional protection under Saudia Personal Data Protection law (PDPL) and European Union and UK data protection law and is referred to here as “sensitive personal data”. Generally, we try to limit the circumstances where we collect and process sensitive personal data. Examples of where we may collect and process ’sensitive personal data’ includes the following:

    • You have requested specific medical assistance from us and/or an airport operator, such as the provision of wheelchair assistance or oxygen.
    • You have sought clearance from us to fly with a medical condition or because you are more than 28 weeks pregnant.
    • You have otherwise chosen to provide such information to us or it has been passed onto us by a third party such as the travel agent through which you made your booking.
    • Biometric information (for example, facial recognition) may be collected during the security clearance process prior to, and after, flying with us.
    • In addition, you may have requested services (such as a meal) which is not ’sensitive data’ but may imply or suggest your religion, health or other information.

    What do we use your personal information for?

    1. Travel Services and Contractual Obligations

    • To fulfil your travel arrangements and deliver the services you have asked for, including ticketing, bookings, changes, cancellations, refunds, upgrades, and ancillary services.
    • To manage the boarding process, baggage handling, lounge access, and to facilitate flight connections at the airport.
    • To keep track of you in advance of your flight and at the airport to support operational efficiency and passenger safety.
    • To send status updates, operational notifications, and service communications related to your travel.

    2. Safety, Security, and Regulatory Compliance

    • To help keep you safe when you fly with us and to ensure aviation safety and security.
    • To comply with applicable aviation, immigration, border control, security, and regulatory requirements.
    • To transmit passenger data to competent government authorities, including immigration, border control, aviation security, and public health authorities, where legally required.

    3. Fraud Prevention and Legal Purposes

    • To prevent, detect, and investigate fraud, misuse of services, payment fraud, identity theft, and other unlawful activities.
    • To pursue legal claims, manage disputes, conduct debt recovery, and protect Saudia’s legal rights.

      • 4. Customer Support and Service Improvement

      • To handle customer enquiries, complaints, feedback, and service recovery activities.
      • To improve our websites, digital platforms, apps, products, and services.
      • To carry out operational analysis, analytics, and market research to improve our services and customer experience.
      • To produce aggregated and anonymized statistics for reporting, analysis, and service improvement purposes.
      • To operate and manage customer call center services.

      5.Marketing, Personalized Advertising Consent, and Communications

       

      I agree that Saudia may use my contact details (such as email address and mobile number) to send me marketing communications.

      I also agree that Saudia may securely hash these details and share them with trusted advertising platforms to:

      • Measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns
      • Create customized and similar-profile advertising audiences so that I receive more relevant promotional content.
      • Use your browsing behavior, search history, booking activity, and contextual information (such as location and device) to create a “Just for You” package of fare families and ancillaries, and to provide more relevant communications, personalized offers, and tailored experiences, including during the booking process, where permitted by applicable law or based on your consent.

        • I understand that no raw personal data is shared and that I can withdraw my consent at any time through my account settings or by contacting Saudia’s Data Protection Office Conduct Form.

      • To provide services tailored to your requirements and to treat you in a more personal way, where permitted by law.
      • To carry out marketing and promotional activities, including online advertising, and to keep you informed of Saudia products and services, where permitted by law or based on your consent.
      • To undertake targeted online advertising, where permitted by law or based on your consent.
      • To enhance conversion features to securely match your conversions to Google accounts, where applicable.

      6. Advertising Audience Matching and Profiling

      • Match existing customers with corresponding user accounts on third-party advertising platforms
      • Measure advertising campaign performance
      • Create audience segments and similar-profile (lookalike) audiences to deliver more relevant advertising content.
      • Use hashed contact details (such as email and mobile number) to securely perform matching without sharing raw personal data
      • Process such data only where permitted by applicable law or based on your consent, and provide the ability to opt out at any time
      • Use data solely for matching, segmentation, and advertising purposes, and not to directly identify individuals

        • No raw or directly identifiable personal data is shared in this process. These partners are contractually required to use the hashed data solely for the purposes described above and to apply appropriate technical and organizational security safeguards.

      7. IT Systems, Governance, and Business Operations

      • To ensure the security, integrity, availability, and proper functioning of our IT systems, digital platforms, and operational infrastructure.
      • To conduct internal audits, compliance reviews, risk management, and governance activities.
      • For management, administrative, financial, and internal business operations.
      • To maintain records in accordance with applicable legal, regulatory, tax, and accounting requirements..
      • To communicate with you for business-to-business purposes where an existing or intended business relationship exists.
      • To deliver products, applications, services, new technologies, and related solutions to customers.

      Artificial Intelligence, Automated Processing, and Emerging Technologies

      Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies

      SAUDIA is committed to leveraging modern technologies to support the development of its services, improve operational efficiency, strengthen security, and enhance the quality of services provided to guests. In this context, SAUDIA may use artificial intelligence, machine learning, advanced analytics, identity verification, document recognition, and other emerging digital technologies for lawful purposes related to the development, testing, evaluation, improvement, validation, or security of its systems, services, and operational processes.

      For these purposes, SAUDIA may process relevant personal data, including identity data, booking information, travel documents, images, sensitive personal data, or biometric data, where such processing is necessary and proportionate to the purpose pursued and is carried out in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

      SAUDIA applies appropriate technical, organizational, and administrative measures to protect personal data and preserve its confidentiality, integrity, and security. Processing will be limited to the minimum amount of personal data necessary for the specified purpose, taking into account the principles of necessity, proportionality, and data minimization.

      Where required, SAUDIA may engage specialized entities, technology service providers, cloud service providers, artificial intelligence solution providers, or other service providers that process personal data on SAUDIA’s behalf and in accordance with its documented instructions. Such processing will be subject to appropriate contractual obligations requiring the service provider to protect personal data, maintain confidentiality, implement appropriate security measures, and process the data solely for the purposes authorized by SAUDIA.

      Where feasible and appropriate, SAUDIA may use anonymized, pseudonymized, masked, or synthetic data for development, testing, analysis, innovation, and proof-of-concept activities to reduce privacy risks and enhance the protection of personal data.

      No entity receiving or accessing personal data on behalf of SAUDIA may use that data for its own purposes, disclose it to another party, or use it to develop, train, retrain, or improve its own models, systems, products, or services, unless such use is permitted under applicable law, has been expressly disclosed, and is supported by an appropriate legal basis.

      Sharing with Technology and AI Service Providers

      Where necessary and to the extent required for lawful purposes, SAUDIA may share personal data with technology service providers, cloud service providers, artificial intelligence solution providers, identity and document verification providers, and advisory or technical entities providing services, solutions, or technical support to SAUDIA. Such sharing may take place for the provision, development, testing, proof-of-concept, evaluation, improvement, security, or validation of services, systems, and operational processes, subject to appropriate legal, contractual, organizational, and technical safeguards.

      Sensitive Personal Data and Biometric Data

      Where processing involves sensitive personal data or biometric data, including the scanning or analysis of travel documents, document images, facial images, or biometric characteristics, SAUDIA will apply enhanced safeguards proportionate to the nature of the data and the associated risks. Such processing will be limited to specified, explicit, and lawful purposes, including identity verification, travel document validation, fraud prevention, aviation safety and security, service improvement, technical evaluation, and proof-of-concept activities, in accordance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

      When will we send you marketing?

      When we have your permission, we will send you marketing communications from Saudia. As Saudia, we do sometimes send marketing communications that include a business partners’ products and services related to the travel you are undertaking, as well as our own.

      We will only allow third parties or other members of our group to send marketing communications to you when we have agreed marketing from third parties.

      We will respect your choice as to what communications you wish to receive and how these are sent.

      How can you change what marketing communications you receive, how you receive them and unsubscribe?

      If you decide you would no longer like to be sent marketing communications, you can change your mind at any time. The ways to stop being sent marketing communications, If you are an Loyalty Member you can change your marketing preferences at any time in your online account.

      In addition, each marketing communication we send by email will also have an unsubscribe option which will allow you to stop you receiving further marketing emails. We aim to action requests to stop being sent marketing communications within 10 working days of receiving those requests, but it is possible you will receive some marketing in the period prior to that change being made.

      Please note that if you tell us that you do not wish to be sent further marketing communications, you will still receive service communications (as described above) which are necessary, for example, to confirm your booking or to provide you with an update on its status.

      What is our legal basis for using your personal information?

      Saudia will only process your personal information where we have a legal basis to do so. The legal basis will depend on the reason or reasons Saudia collected and needs to use your information. Under Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and UK/ EU General Data Protection Regulations (GDPR) in almost all cases the legal basis will be:

      • Because we need to use your information so that we can process your booking, fulfill your travel arrangements and otherwise perform the contract we have with you.
      • Because it is in Saudia legitimate interests as an airline to use your personal information to operate and improve our business as an airline and travel provider.
      • Because Saudia needs to use your personal information to comply with a legal obligation.
      • To protect the vital interests of you or another person.
      • Because you have consented to Saudia using your information for a particular purpose.

      More information on each legal basis is provided below.

      If processing of your data is subject to any other laws, then the basis of processing your data may be different to that set out above and may in those circumstances be based on your consent in all cases.

      How long do we keep personal information?

      We will keep your information for as long as we need it for the purpose it is being processed for. For example, where you book a flight with us we will keep the information related to your booking, so we can fulfill the specific travel arrangements you have made and after that, we will keep the information for a period which enables us to handle or respond to any complaints, queries or concerns relating to the booking. 

      The information may also be retained so that we can continue to improve your experience with us and to ensure that you receive any loyalty rewards which are due to you.

      We will actively review the information we hold and delete it securely, or in some cases anonymise it, when there is no longer a legal, business or customer need for it to be retained. If you stop interacting with us as a customer, we will remove or anonymise your information after 7 years.

      Third-Party Websites

      Our websites and platforms may contain links to external websites operated by third parties. Please note that this Privacy Notice does not apply to your use of any third-party website.

      We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of websites that are not operated by a Saudia entity. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party websites you visit.

      What Data Do We Process When You Visit Our Website?

      When you visit our website, we use cookies and similar technologies such as tracking URLs to operate, protect, and enhance our website and applications. These technologies help us ensure proper functionality, improve performance, and better understand how our services are used.

      For more detailed information about the types of data processed and the third parties involved, please refer to our Cookie Policy.

      Personal Information We Collect When You Use Our Platforms

      Our websites, applications, and digital platforms use cookies and similar technologies. It helps us understand how you use our Platforms and navigate the internet, allowing us to improve our services and personalize certain content. Cookies may collect personal information about you.

      For more details about how we use your personal information and how you can manage your cookie preferences Cookies policy.

      We also use monitoring tools on our Platforms to track your user journey. This helps us ensure your experience meets expectations and allows us to identify and resolve technical errors or issues.

      Flight Status and Disruption Notifications

      When making or updating a booking, or through your customer membership profile, you may choose to provide your mobile phone number and/or email address. This allows us to send you your boarding pass and enable you to use the Saudia app in connection with your flight.

      We may notify you by SMS, email, or through the app about changes to your flight status, including delays, cancellations, or other disruptions.

      Making a Booking on Behalf of Another Person

      If you make a booking for someone else, you are responsible for obtaining their permission to share their personal information with us. We will assume that you have obtained this permission before completing the booking.

      You are also responsible for providing the necessary details to complete the booking, such as the person’s full name and passport information, and for informing them about how we will use their personal information in accordance with this Privacy Policy. Where required by local laws, we recommend that you keep a record of their consent and provide them with a copy of, or a link to, this Privacy Policy.

      Each person included in a booking may be able to view and update the phone number and/or email address of the other person(s) in the same booking. Operational communications sent to one passenger may also be sent to the person who made the booking.

      Personal Information Used for Legal, Regulatory, and Security Purposes

      We process your personal information to comply with applicable legal, regulatory, and compliance obligations. This includes responding to valid legal requests such as court orders, subpoenas, claims, or regulatory requirements, and protecting our property, rights, and interests, as well as those of others.

      We also use your personal information to prevent and detect crime, including fraud related to online payments and loyalty programs.

      Personal Information We Obtain from Third Parties

      We may receive personal information about you from third parties whom you have authorized to share your details with us. This may include, for example, your travel agent, a person making a booking on your behalf, a travel companion, a travel coordinator, co-branded credit card partners, duty-free retailers, social media platforms, or other digital service providers.

      We combine this information with the data we collect directly from you or generate about you, and use it for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy.

      We may also receive personal information from individuals who refer you to our loyalty programs, products, or services. In such cases, we request that those individuals confirm that you are willing to receive communications from us.

      Performance of a contract with you

      It will be necessary for Saudia to use your personal information to complete a booking you have made with us. For example, we will need to use information such as your contact details and payment information to provide you with the flight, holiday and/or car hire you have requested and paid for.

      Legitimate Interests

      As a commercial airline and travel provider Saudia
